visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a split-screen layout. On the top right, a man wearing a grey baseball cap, dark sunglasses, and a white t-shirt is visible against a neutral background. He gestures with his hands while looking off-camera. The main portion of the screen displays mobile MOBA gameplay. A green, robotic character is moving through a forested map with stone structures and red icons indicating enemy positions. (2) As the gameplay progresses, the camera follows the green character into a team fight. Bright green and blue light effects appear as abilities are cast. The man in the inset window continues to speak, his facial expressions shifting from focused to slightly amused. Text overlays appear at the bottom, and social media handles are visible in the lower corners. (3) The man leans back and laughs heartily, exposing his teeth and tilting his head upward. On the game screen, more combat occurs with various character models clashing. Numerical damage indicators and 'Killed' icons flash briefly. The background remains consistent with the game's arena environment. (4) The video concludes with the man making a final comment while gesturing towards the camera. The gameplay screen fades slightly, emphasizing the social media logos for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook at the bottom. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the clip.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a calm male voice speaking Chinese with a questioning tone. A light electronic BGM with a steady 120 BPM beat provides a backing track. Subtle digital sound effects from the game UI, like soft pings and clicks, are audible. (2) As the gameplay intensifies, the male voice rises in pitch and volume, reacting to the onscreen actions with excitement. Rapid percussion and synth textures in the music swell slightly. Impact SFX, such as thuds and swooshes from the game characters' abilities, become more frequent. (3) The speaker begins humming a rhythmic melody ('dup-dup-di-dup') that matches the beat of the BGM. This creates a playful atmosphere. The vocal energy remains high, with frequent variations in intonation to convey humor. (4) The sequence peaks with a loud, boisterous laugh from the speaker, followed by a series of comedic, loud phrases in Chinese. The BGM continues smoothly, and the audio concludes with a final, slightly softer explanatory sentence, maintaining a friendly and humorous tone.
